script.code:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS id, j.organization_id, j.command, j.job_status, j.lease_owner, (j.lease_expires_at > n.t) AS lease_live, j.row_version,
       j.attempt_count, j.idempotency_key, j.correlation_id, j.request_payload, j.is_deleted,
       CAST(li.id AS CHAR) AS linked_ia, li.stock_movement_no AS linked_ia_no, CAST(li.stock_movement_no_type AS CHAR) AS linked_ia_no_type
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN gd_async_job j
    ON j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IPguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.id = {{node:code_node_IPguard.data.jobId}}
  LEFT JOIN sm_item_assembly li
    ON li.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IPguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND li.id = (SELECT MAX(g.id) FROM sm_item_assembly g
                 WHERE g.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IPguard.data.tenantId}}' AND g.ia_v2_job_id = '{{node:code_node_IPguard.data.jobId}}' AND g.item_assembly_status = 'Processing' AND g.is_deleted = 0
                   AND COALESCE((SELECT p.result_ref FROM gd_publish_step p
                                  WHERE p.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IPguard.data.tenantId}}' AND p.job_id = (CONCAT('IAC|', CAST(g.id AS CHAR)) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci)
                                    AND p.step_name LIKE 'LOCK|%' AND p.is_deleted = 0
                                  ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 1), j.idempotency_key) = j.idempotency_key)

script.code:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       CAST(h.id AS CHAR) AS ia_id, h.item_assembly_status, h.ia_v2_job_id AS ia_v2_job_id, h.stock_movement_no,
       (SELECT p.result_ref
          FROM gd_publish_step p
         WHERE p.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IPentry.data.tenantId}}'
           AND p.job_id = 'IAC|{{node:code_node_IPentry.data.iaId}}'
           AND p.step_name LIKE 'LOCK|%' AND p.is_deleted = 0
         ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS lock_ref,
       (SELECT p.step_name
          FROM gd_publish_step p
         WHERE p.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IPentry.data.tenantId}}'
           AND p.job_id = 'IAC|{{node:code_node_IPentry.data.iaId}}'
           AND p.step_name LIKE 'LOCK|%' AND p.is_deleted = 0
         ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS lock_step
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN sm_item_assembly h
    ON h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IPentry.data.tenantId}}'
   AND h.id = {{node:code_node_IPentry.data.iaId}}
   AND h.is_deleted = 0

script.code:
SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(i.id AS CHAR), 'material_code', i.material_code, 'material_name', i.material_name,
       'stock_control', i.stock_control, 'show_delivery', i.show_delivery, 'serial_number_management', i.serial_number_management,
       'item_batch_management', i.item_batch_management, 'batch_number_genaration', i.batch_number_genaration,
       'material_costing_method', i.material_costing_method, 'purchase_unit_price', CAST(i.purchase_unit_price AS CHAR),
       'assembly_cost', CAST(i.assembly_cost AS CHAR), 'based_uom', CAST(i.based_uom AS CHAR),
       'table_uom_conversion', COALESCE((SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('alt_uom_id', CAST(u.alt_uom_id AS CHAR), 'base_qty', u.base_qty))
                                   FROM item_mji552rc_sub u
                                  WHERE u.Item_id = i.id AND u.is_deleted = 0), JSON_ARRAY())) AS j
  FROM item i
 WHERE i.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IPentry.data.tenantId}}'
   AND i.id IN (SELECT k.v
                   FROM (SELECT CAST(h.item_id AS UNSIGNED) AS v FROM sm_item_assembly h WHERE h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND h.id = {{node:code_node_IPentry.data.iaId}} AND h.is_deleted = 0 AND h.item_id REGEXP '^[0-9]{1,20}$'
                         UNION
                         SELECT CAST(l.item_selection AS UNSIGNED) FROM sm_item_assembly_tlm8ve69_sub l WHERE l.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND l.sm_item_assembly_id = {{node:code_node_IPentry.data.iaId}} AND l.is_deleted = 0 AND l.item_selection REGEXP '^[0-9]{1,20}$') k)
   AND i.is_deleted = 0

script.code:
SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(b.id AS CHAR), 'bin', b.bin_location_combine) AS j
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT k.v
          FROM (SELECT h.location_id AS v FROM sm_item_assembly h WHERE h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND h.id = {{node:code_node_IPentry.data.iaId}} AND h.is_deleted = 0
                UNION ALL
                SELECT CAST(t.loc AS UNSIGNED)
                  FROM sm_item_assembly_tlm8ve69_sub l,
                       JSON_TABLE(IF(JSON_VALID(l.temp_qty_data), l.temp_qty_data, '[]'), '$[*]' COLUMNS (loc VARCHAR(32) PATH '$.location_id')) t
                 WHERE l.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND l.sm_item_assembly_id = {{node:code_node_IPentry.data.iaId}} AND l.is_deleted = 0 AND t.loc REGEXP '^[0-9]{1,20}$') k) x
  JOIN bin_location b
    ON b.id = x.v
 WHERE b.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IPentry.data.tenantId}}'
   AND b.is_deleted = 0
 ORDER BY b.id

script.code:
SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT h.material_hold_status FROM sm_item_assembly h WHERE h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND h.id = {{node:code_node_IPentry.data.iaId}}) <> '' THEN JSON_OBJECT(
       'hold', (SELECT h.material_hold_status FROM sm_item_assembly h WHERE h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND h.id = {{node:code_node_IPentry.data.iaId}}),
       'rows', (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(r.id AS CHAR), 'status', r.status, 'doc_line_id', r.doc_line_id, 'material_id', CAST(r.material_id AS CHAR),
                'bin_location', CAST(r.bin_location AS CHAR), 'batch_id', CAST(r.batch_id AS CHAR), 'from_category', r.from_category, 'open_qty', CAST(r.open_qty AS CHAR),
                'item_uom', CAST(r.item_uom AS CHAR)))
                FROM on_reserved_gd r WHERE r.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND r.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_IPentry.data.organizationId}}' AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.doc_type = 'Item Assembly'
                 AND r.doc_id = '{{node:code_node_IPentry.data.iaId}}' AND r.status IN ('Allocated', 'Processing', 'Releasing')),
       'live', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gd_publish_step p WHERE p.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IPentry.data.tenantId}}' AND p.job_id = 'IAH|{{node:code_node_IPentry.data.iaId}}' AND p.step_name LIKE 'TICKET|%' AND p.step_status = 'HELD'
                 AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND p.started_at > CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), '+00:00', '+08:00') - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE)) ELSE JSON_OBJECT('hold', '', 'rows',
		NULL, 'live', 0) END AS j
